side.title: LAN access

index.fair.locked: One song queued · wait your turn
index.fair.submit_lock: One song per person at a time; you can request again after yours finishes
index.fair.nick_lock: Nickname is locked while your song is queued
msg.not_json: The server answered with a web page instead of JSON - this port is probably not KaraQueue (check that the node process started and the port is not taken)
admin.skip: Skip current, play next at once
admin.dup_label: Allow the same song in the queue more than once
admin.dup_desc:
Off: a duplicate submission of a playing or queued track is rejected.
On: the same track may appear in the queue multiple times.
admin.fair_label: Fair rotation · one song per guest
admin.fair_desc: While on, each guest (identified by a browser cookie, unaffected by nickname edits) can hold only one playing or queued track and must wait for it to finish; while locked, the guest's submit button greys out and the nickname input locks on the request page.
admin.queue_hint: ⤒ move to front · ↑↓ reorder · ✕ remove. Changes broadcast live to the big screen and all request pages.
srv.parse_failed: Unrecognized video link (paste a Bilibili BV/av id or a full video link)
srv.b23_expand_failed: Could not expand the b23 short link (network or risk control). Paste the full link or a BV id instead
srv.bili_412: Bilibili flagged this client as suspicious (HTTP 412); retry later or let cached metadata fill in first
srv.bili_html: Bilibili answered with a web page instead of JSON (HTTP {status}), probably risk control
srv.yt_401: The video's YouTube metadata is locked (private or embedding disabled)
srv.yt_404: The video does not exist on YouTube (404)
srv.yt_html: YouTube answered with a web page instead of JSON (HTTP {status})
srv.warn_bili_cache: Bilibili API temporarily unavailable (risk control or network); using previously cached metadata
srv.warn_bili_nocache: Bilibili API temporarily unavailable (risk control or network); queued as a bare link, title info missing for now
srv.warn_yt_cache: YouTube metadata temporarily unavailable (network or permissions); using previously cached metadata
srv.warn_yt_nocache: YouTube metadata temporarily unavailable (network or permissions); queued as a bare link, title info missing for now
srv.fair_locked_playing: One active request per guest: "{title}" is playing now. You can request again once it finishes
srv.fair_locked_queued: One active request per guest: "{title}" is still in the queue. You can request again once it finishes
srv.dup_queued: Request rejected: "{title}" (P{page}) is already in the queue

srv.withdraw_missing: This track is no longer in the queue (it probably finished or was removed)
srv.reorder_not_in_queue: That track is not in the queue
